options.name: state
options.description: The virtual address state. If C(absent), an attempt to delete the virtual address will be made. This will only succeed if this virtual address is not in use by a virtual server. C(present) creates the virtual address and enables it. If C(enabled), enables the virtual address if it exists. If C(disabled), creates the virtual address if needed, and sets state to C(disabled).
